name: Villager Paintings
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: SuperWarioModTeam
description: Adds a collection of Villager themed paintings featuring every villager profession, all biome variants, Iron Golems, and several special villagers from MC Dungeons
works: 37 painting variants (namespace villager_paintings) of villager professions, biome villagers, iron golems and Dungeons merchants, added to the placeable tag so they come up when a painting is hung.
note: From Modrinth, unchanged (with its data from Horizon's mod browser). Not yet: The paintings' pictures are the mod's textures, which may not show; the steps check the variant exists; the mod works without it
